project.title: Milestones
project.caption: The project's milestones, earliest forecast first

register.title: Milestone register
register.description: Every milestone of the projects you can see, earliest forecast first, with where its achievement claim stands.
register.caption: Milestones of every project you can see

returned.title: Returned for correction
returned.noReason: Returned without a reason: the claim was withdrawn from review.

project.title: This project has no milestones yet
project.planner: Add the milestones the project will be measured against: each gets a forecast date, and its achievement is claimed here once it happens.
project.waiting: The Project Manager has not planned any milestone yet.
project.notPlanned: Milestones are planned once the project is approved.
project.noLonger: No milestones were planned for this project, and none are added while it is suspended, completed or closed.

register.title: No milestones to show
register.body: Milestones appear here once a Project Manager plans them in a project you can see.

filtered.title: No milestone matches this choice
filtered.body: Choose "All milestones" to see every milestone again.

form.intro: A milestone belongs to the project's schedule. Its achievement is claimed separately, once it happens.
form.categoriesUnreadable: The categories cannot be read with your access; the current one is kept.
form.categoriesUnreadableCreate: The milestone categories cannot be read with your access, so a milestone cannot be added here. Ask an administrator for access to master data.
form.forecastHint: The date the milestone is currently expected on.
form.activitiesUnreadable: The schedule's activities cannot be read with your access, so no activity can be chosen.
form.activityHint: Optional: the schedule activity whose completion this milestone marks.
form.sortOrderHint: Optional: a whole number from 0, to order milestones forecast for the same date.

claim.title: Achievement claim
claim.forbidden: You do not have access to this milestone's achievement claims.
claim.correctionNote: A correction is a new revision. The accepted achievement stays as it is until the correction is accepted.
claim.dateHint: The date the milestone was achieved on. It cannot be after today.
claim.narrativeHint: Optional: what was delivered, for the reviewer.
claim.evidenceNext: The claim is saved as a draft. You then attach its evidence and submit it for review.
claim.submittedBy: Submitted by {person} on {date}. It is with AHDA for review and cannot be changed meanwhile.
claim.draftReadOnly: A draft prepared by the Project Manager. Only they can change or submit it.
claim.deleteBody: Delete this draft claim? Its evidence links end with it. Earlier revisions are not affected.

why.cancelled: This milestone is cancelled, so its achievement cannot be claimed.
why.notManager: Only the project's Project Manager claims its milestones' achievements.
why.projectNotActive: Achievements are claimed while the project is active.

evidence.title: Evidence

pending.title: Evidence is optional pending policy
pending.body: No evidence policy has been published yet (PTBC-006), so no evidence is mandatory and the server accepts this claim without any. The reviewer sees whatever you attach.

notRequired.title: No evidence is required
notRequired.body: The evidence policy in force makes no evidence mandatory for this milestone's category.

required.title: The evidence policy in force requires:

undetermined.title: The evidence policy cannot be determined
undetermined.body: The server cannot read the evidence policy unambiguously, so it refuses every submission until AHDA corrects the policy.

evidence.doesNotCount: Does not count: the version is not clean
evidence.uploadHint: A new upload is scanned first; attach it once the scan finds it clean.

submit.title: Submit for review
submit.missing: Attach the evidence the policy requires before submitting. Missing: {types}.
submit.undetermined: The claim cannot be submitted while the evidence policy cannot be determined.
submit.saveFirst: Save your changes to the claim before submitting it.
submit.confirmWithoutEvidence: No evidence is attached. Nothing is mandatory until an evidence policy is published, so the server will accept this claim without evidence. Submit it without evidence?

cancel.body: Cancel this milestone? A cancelled milestone stays in the schedule's history and can no longer be claimed or changed.

done.claimOpened: The claim was saved as a draft. Attach its evidence, then submit it.
done.submitted: The claim was submitted for review.
done.stale: Someone changed this milestone or its claim meanwhile. It was read again; nothing was changed.

problems.projectNotActive: Achievements are claimed while the project is active. Nothing was changed.
problems.notClaimable: This milestone is cancelled or no longer available, so it cannot be claimed.
problems.claimedDateInvalid: The date achieved cannot be after today.
problems.achievementOpen: This milestone already has a claim in draft or under review.
problems.achievementNotEditable: Only a draft claim can be changed.
problems.evidenceRequired: The server refused the submission: the evidence the policy requires is not all attached and clean. The evidence was read again.
problems.scheduleProjectNotEligible: Milestones are planned while the project is approved or active.
problems.scheduleNotInitialized: The project's schedule has not been started yet. Start it in the Schedule tab first.
problems.scheduleNotEditable: This milestone cannot be changed: it is achieved or cancelled, or a baseline is with AHDA for approval.
problems.activityInvalid: Choose a live activity of this project's schedule.
problems.linkEnded: This document was detached from the claim earlier and cannot be attached to it again. Upload it as a new document.
problems.evidenceWithdrawn: This version was withdrawn from the claim earlier and cannot be attached again. Upload a new version of the document.
problems.configurationMissing: The approval route or the evidence policy for milestone achievements is not configured. Ask AHDA to publish it.
problems.invalidTransition: This claim or milestone is no longer in a state that allows this.
problems.permissionDenied: You are not allowed to do this.

fieldErrors.claimedDateInFuture: The date achieved cannot be after today.
fieldErrors.categoryInvalid: This category is not published. Choose another.
fieldErrors.activityInvalid: This activity is not a live activity of the project's schedule.
fieldErrors.evidenceTypeInvalid: This evidence type is not published. Choose another.
